Import: from tts.chain import TTSChain, build_tts_chain Import: from tts.params import TTSParams, EmotionState Import: from llm.conversation import ConversationEngine
async def _tts_stream( sentence_gen: AsyncGenerator[str, None], cur_turn: int, t_start: float, emotion: EmotionState, tts_chain: TTSChain, interrupt: asyncio.Event, min_chars: int, ) → None: splitter = SentenceSplitter(min_chars=min_chars) first = True async for token in sentence_gen: if interrupt.is_set(): break for sentence in splitter.feed(token): if interrupt.is_set(): break params = emotion.to_tts_params(tts_chain.primary_engine_name()) beat = BeatPayload(text=sentence, ...) await _send_beat(ws, beat) if tts_chain: async for chunk in tts_chain.stream_synthesize(sentence, params): if interrupt.is_set(): break await _send_audio(ws, chunk, cur_turn) if first: logger.info("TTFA=%.0fms", (time.perf_counter()-t_start)*1000) first = False for sentence in splitter.flush(): if not interrupt.is_set(): params = emotion.to_tts_params(tts_chain.primary_engine_name()) audio = await tts_chain.synthesize(sentence, params) await _send_audio(ws, audio, cur_turn)

decisions.decision: qwen2.5:3b via Ollama — sweet spot: tiếng Việt tốt, first token ~200ms Mac M-series, tách biệt model NLU (ai_settings.ollamaModel) vs conversation (conversation_settings.ollamaModel)

Gộp vào NLU call (Option A): một LLM round-trip, thêm field "emotion" vào JSON output. Nếu parse fail → default "neutral", NLU vẫn hoạt động bình thường. Toggle qua sentimentEnabled trong conversation_settings.

Yield triggers (priority order): 1. [.!?…] → always yield 2. [,;] + buffer >= min_chars → yield (clause end) 3. ends with ("ạ,"|"nhé,"|"nha,") + buffer >= min_chars → yield 4. buffer >= 100 chars + next space → force yield (no word cut) Rule 4: LUÔN split tại space, không bao giờ giữa chữ. min_chars configurable qua DB, default 30.

Streaming ở cấp độ câu (sentence-level), không phải token. ElevenLabs: stream_synthesize() per sentence → yield PCM chunks realtime. EdgeTTS: synthesize() full sentence → yield as single chunk (batch, acceptable cho fallback). Câu N+1 được queue trong khi câu N đang stream audio.

Active sessions không bị reload khi admin đổi config — acceptable. Chỉ session mới pick up config mới (Redis cache invalidated → next RemoteConfig.load()). Nếu cần force reload active sessions: cần Redis pub/sub → ws.py subscribe → out of scope.

TTSChain build per-session (khi WS connect), không phải module-level singleton. Lý do: config có thể thay đổi giữa các sessions, cần pick up fresh từ remote_config. Circuit breaker state chia sẻ qua Redis (không phải in-memory per-instance).
